description: This file defines a React component 'ProtectedRoute' that enforces authentication and role-based authorization for routing. It also includes a helper component 'AccessDenied' for unauthorized access UI. The component uses React Router API such as Navigate and Outlet, and a custom authentication hook 'useAuth'.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute({ children, requiredRoles = [], fallbackPath = '/login', unauthorizedFallback = null, })
methods.description: React component that validates user authentication and authorization based on roles, rendering children/components or redirecting as needed.

methods.name: AccessDenied()
methods.description: Component displaying an 'Access Denied' message, used for unauthorized access when user is authenticated but lacks required roles.

ctags.name: fallbackPath
ctags.pattern: /^    return <Navigate to={fallbackPath} replace state={{ from: location }} \/>;$/

fields.name: return <Navigate to={fallbackPath} replace state={{ from: location }} \/>;
